prog = '''\
from arc_dsl import *
def solve(grid):
    objs = objects(grid, True, False, True)
    info = [(o, color(o), ulcorner(o), shp(o), size(o)) for o in objs]

'''

def Lobject(grid):
    # find bar+stem corner object: object whose cells = horizontal segment + vertical segment sharing an end cell
    g,info,cs,cc=objinfo(grid)
    best=None
    for o,c,ul,s,sz in info:
        cells=set(toindices(o))
        rows={}
        cols={}
        for r,cc2 in cells: rows.setdefault(r,[]).append(cc2); cols.setdefault(cc2,[]).append(r)
        hl=[(r,min(v),max(v)) for r,v in rows.items() if len(v)==max(len(x) for x in rows.values())]
        vl=[(c2,min(v),max(v)) for c2,v in cols.items() if len(v)==max(len(x) for x in cols.values())]
        if not rows or not cols: continue
        maxr=max(len(v) for v in rows.values()); maxc=max(len(v) for v in cols.values())
        if maxr>=2 and maxc>=2 and sz==maxr+maxc-1:
            if best is None or sz>best[4]: best=(o,c,ul,s,sz)
    return best

def feats(o, L, grid):

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    dmin=lambda cells: min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) for a in cells for b in cells)
    # stem/bar/corner from L shape
    rows={}
    for r,c2 in Lc: rows.setdefault(r,[]).append(c2)
    cols={}
    for r,c2 in Lc: cols.setdefault(c2,[]).append(r)
    bar=(max(rows,key=lambda r:len(rows[r]))); bart=row_bar=(bar,min(rows[bar]),max(rows[bar]))
    scol=max(cols,key=lambda c2:len(cols[c2])); stem=(scol,min(cols[scol]),max(cols[scol]))
    cornert=None
    for cell in Lc:
        if cell[0]==bar and cell[1]==scol: cornert=cell
    stiptip=(stem[1] if stem[1]<stem[2] else stem[2], scol)  # placeholder
    tip_s=(min(cols[scol]),scol) if len(cols[scol])==2 or True else None
    # stem tip = end of stem away from bar
    ends=[(stem[1],scol),(stem[2],scol)]
    tip_s=[e for e in ends if abs(e[0]-bar)>0][0] if len(ends)==2 else None
    tip_s=(stem[1] if stem[1]!=bar else stem[2], scol)
    bends=[(bar,bart[1]),(bar,bart[2])]
    tip_b=[e for e in bends if e[1]!=scol][0]
    ors=sorted(set(r for r,c2 in cs_)); ocs=sorted(set(c2 for r,c2 in cs_))
    f={}
    f['d_L']=dmin(cs_|{-999:None} if False else cs_) if False else min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) for a in cs_ for b in Lc)
    f['d_tipS']=min(abs(a[0]-tip_s[0])+abs(a[1]-tip_s[1]) for a in cs_)
    f['d_tipB']=min(abs(a[0]-tip_b[0])+abs(a[1]-tip_b[1]) for a in cs_)
    f['d_corner']=min(abs(a[0]-cornert[0])+abs(a[1]-cornert[1]) for a in cs_)
    f['size']=len(cs_)
    f['entirely_left_stem']=max(ocs)<scol
    f['entirely_right_stem']=min(ocs)>scol
    f['straddle_stem']=min(ocs)<scol<max(ocs)
    f['touches_stemcol']=scol in ocs
    f['above_bar']=max(r for r,c2 in cs_)<bar
    f['below_bar']=min(r for r,c2 in cs_)>bar
    f['straddle_barrow']=any(r==bar for r,c2 in cs_)
    f['up_left_open']= (max(r for r,c2 in cs_)<bar) and (max(ocs)<scol)
    return f

import itertools

def objlist(grid):
    g,info,cs,cc=objinfo(grid)
    return [(set(toindices(o)), c, ul, sz) for o,c,ul,s,sz in info]

def Lshape(objs):
    best=None
    for cs_,c,ul,sz in objs:
        rows={}; cols={}
        for r,cc2 in cs_: rows.setdefault(r,[]).append(cc2); cols.setdefault(cc2,[]).append(r)
        mr=max(len(v) for v in rows.values()); mc=max(len(v) for v in cols.values())
        if mr>=2 and mc>=2 and sz==mr+mc-1:
            if best is None or sz>best[3]: best=(cs_,c,ul,sz)
    return best

def geo(cs_):
    rs=[r for r,c in cs_]; ccs=[c for r,c in cs_]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(ccs),max(ccs)

def features(cs_, c, objs, L, grid):
    Lc,Lcol,Lul,Lsz=L
    r0,r1,c0,c1=geo(cs_); LR0,LR1,LC0,LC1=geo(Lc)
    rows={}; cols={}
    for r,cc2 in Lc: rows.setdefault(r,[]).append(cc2); cols.setdefault(cc2,[]).append(r)
    brow=max(rows,key=lambda r:len(rows[r])); b0,b1=min(rows[brow]),max(rows[brow])
    scol=max(cols,key=lambda x:len(cols[x])); s0,s1=min(cols[scol]),max(cols[scol])
    corner=(brow,scol) if brow in [r for r,c2 in Lc if c2==scol] else None
    # corner = cell shared conceptually: end of bar nearest stem & end of stem nearest bar
    bart=(brow,b0) if abs(b0-scol)>abs(b1-scol) or b1==scol else (brow,b1)
    bart=(brow, b1 if b1!=scol else b0)
    stip=(s0,scol) if s0!=brow else (s1,scol)

from collections import defaultdict

def solve(grid):
    objs=objlist(grid); L=Lshape(objs)
    nonL=[m for m in objs if m[0]!=L[0]]
    classes=defaultdict(list)
    for m in nonL: classes[nshape(m[0])].append(m)
    exact2={k:v for k,v in classes.items() if len(v)==2}
    samecol=[(max(m[3] for m in v),k,v) for k,v in exact2.items() if v[0][1]==v[1][1]]
    if samecol:
        _,k,v=max(samecol)
    else:
        _,k,v=max((max(m[3] for m in v),k,v) for k,v in exact2.items())
    member=max(v,key=lambda m:min(c for r,c in m[0]))
    out=[list(r) for r in grid]
    for r,c in member[0]: out[r][c]=L[1]
    return tuple(tuple(r) for r in out), member[1], member[2], L[1], (v[0][1],v[1][1])

for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi=tuple(map(tuple,G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])); go=tuple(map(tuple,G[f'Demo pair {n} output']))

    print(f"demo{n}: recolor {mc}@{ul} -> {tc}, pair colors {paircols}, EXACT MATCH: {pred==go}")

def feats2(grid, chg_cells):
    objs=objlist(grid); L=Lshape(objs)
    cs_L,cL,ulL,szL=L
    corner=(max(r for r,c in cs_L), min(c for r,c in cs_L)) if False else None
    # identify bar/stem: corner = cell of L with most neighbors
    from collections import Counter as Ct
    nb=Ct()
    for r,c in cs_L:
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            if (r+dr,c+dc) in cs_L: nb[(r,c)]+=1
    corner=max(nb,key=nb.get)
    # stem direction: the arm from corner with width1
    arms=[]
    for d,(dr,dc) in [('up',(-1,0)),('down',(1,0)),('left',(0,-1)),('right',(0,1))]:
        arm=[]
        r,c=corner
        while (r+dr,c+dc) in cs_L: r,c=r+dr,c+dc; arm.append((r,c))
        arms.append((d,len(arm),r,c))
    armL=[a for a in arms if a[1]>0]
    stem=armL[0]; bar=[a for a in armL if a[0]!=stem[0]][0]
    tip=stem[2],stem[3]; bartip=bar[2],bar[3]
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows=[r for r,c in cs_L]; cols=[c for r,c in cs_L]
    opens={'up':rows==[min(rows)]*2 or min(rows)==0,'down':max(rows)==H-1,'left':min(cols)==0,'right':max(cols)==W-1}
    res=[]
    for m in objs:
        cs_,c,ul,sz=m
        if cs_==cs_L: continue
        chg=cs_==chg_cells
        cells_set=cs_
        rs=[r for r,c in cs_]; cls=[c for r,c in cs_]
        f={}
        f['size']=sz
        f['d_corner']=min(abs(r-corner[0])+abs(c-corner[1]) for r,c in cs_)
        f['d_tip']=min(abs(r-tip[0])+abs(c-tip[1]) for r,c in cs_)
        f['d_bartip']=min(abs(r-bartip[0])+abs(c-bartip[1]) for r,c in cs_)
        f['d_L']=min(abs(r-tr)+abs(c-tc) for r,c in cs_ for tr,tc in cs_L)
        # quadrant rel to corner
        f['q_up']=max(rs)<corner[0]; f['q_down']=min(rs)>corner[0]
        f['q_left']=max(cls)<corner[1]; f['q_right']=min(cls)>corner[1]
        f['touch_top']=min(rs)==0; f['touch_bot']=max(rs)==H-1
        f['touch_left']=min(cls)==0; f['touch_right']=max(cls)==W-1
        # alignment with stem col / bar row
        f['on_stemcol']=any(c==tip[1] for r,c in cs_)
        f['on_barrow']=any(r==bartip[0] for r,c in cs_)
        res.append((f,chg,c,ul,sz))
    return res, dict(corner=corner,tip=tip,bartip=bartip)

# rebuild demos data
D={}
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    gi=tuple(map(tuple,G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])); go=tuple(map(tuple,G[f'Demo pair {n} output']))
    chg=frozenset((r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c])
    D[n]=feats2(gi,chg)
    print(f"demo{n}:", D[n][1])
    for f,chg,c,ul,sz in D[n][0]:
        print('  ',"*" if chg else ' ',f"col{c}@{ul} sz{sz}", {k:v for k,v in f.items() if k!='size'}, "size",sz)

def build(n):
    gi,go,chg=D[n]
    objs=objlist(gi); L=Lshape(objs); csL=L[0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    prs=get_pairs(objs,csL)
    classes=[]
    for k,v in prs.items():
        fts=[dict(
            d_L=min(abs(r-tr)+abs(c-tc) for r,c in m[0] for tr,tc in csL),
            ntouch=sum((min(r for r,c in m[0])==0, max(r for r,c in m[0])==H-1, min(c for r,c in m[0])==0, max(c for r,c in m[0])==W-1)),
            colcnt_objs=sum(1 for o in objs if o[1]==m[1]),
            colcnt_cells=sum(o[3] for o in objs if o[1]==m[1]),
            leftc=min(c for r,c in m[0]), topc=min(r for r,c in m[0]),
            sz=m[3], touchtop=int(min(r for r,c in m[0])==0),
            touchLborder=int(min(c for r,c in m[0])==0),
        ) for m in v]
        classes.append(dict(k=k,v=v,shapesz=len(k),memsz=max(m[3] for m in v),sumsz=sum(m[3] for m in v),
                            samecol=v[0][1]==v[1][1],
                            mind=min(f['d_L'] for f in fts), maxd=max(f['d_L'] for f in fts),
                            ntouchsum=sum(f['ntouch'] for f in fts), fts=fts))
    return objs,L,classes,chg,H,W

DATA={n:build(n) for n in [1,2,3,4,5]}

def build2(n):
    gi,go,chg=D[n]
    objs=objlist(gi); Lobj=Lshape(objs); csL=Lobj[0]; cL=Lobj[1]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    prs=get_pairs(objs,csL)
    lcr=min(r for r,c in csL); lcc=min(c for r,c in csL)  # corner cell approx
    corner=min(csL,key=lambda p:(p[0]+p[1]))
    classes=[]
    for k,v in prs.items():
        def f(m):
            cs_,c,ul,sz=m
            rs=[r for r,c in cs_]; cl=[c for r,c in cs_]
            t=(min(rs)==0,max(rs)==H-1,min(cl)==0,max(cl)==W-1)
            return {'d_L':min(abs(r-tr)+abs(c-tc) for r,c in cs_ for tr,tc in csL),
                    'ntouch':sum(t),'colcnt_objs':sum(1 for o in objs if o[1]==c),
                    'colcnt_cells':sum(o[3] for o in objs if o[1]==c),
                    'leftc':min(cl),'topc':min(rs),'sz':sz,
                    'd_corner':min(abs(r-corner[0])+abs(c-corner[1]) for r,c in cs_),
                    'dcx':abs(sum(r for r,c in cs_)/len(cs_)-sum(r for r,c in csL)/len(csL)),
                    'dcy':abs(sum(c for r,c in cs_)/len(cs_)-sum(c for r,c in csL)/len(csL)),
                    }
        fts=[f(m) for m in v]
        classes.append(dict(k=k,v=v,shapesz=len(k),memsz=max(m[3] for m in v),sumsz=sum(m[3] for m in v),
            samecol=v[0][1]==v[1][1],mind=min(x['d_L'] for x in fts),maxd=max(x['d_L'] for x in fts),
            ntouchsum=sum(x['ntouch'] for x in fts),minntouch=min(x['ntouch'] for x in fts),
            colcntsum=sum(x['colcnt_objs'] for x in fts),fts=fts,c=corner))
    return objs,Lobj,classes,chg,H,W,corner

D2_={n:build2(n) for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6]}
# class-level selector search: pick class via key; member via (feature, order) with implicit rightmost tie-break
def clskey_options():
    opts={}
    for f in ['shapesz','memsz','sumsz','mind','maxd','ntouchsum','minntouch','colcntsum']:
        opts['max_'+f]=lambda cl,f=f: cl[f]
        opts['min_'+f]=lambda cl,f=f: -cl[f]
    return opts

MEMF=['d_L','ntouch','colcnt_objs','colcnt_cells','leftc','topc','sz','d_corner','dcx','dcy']
results=[]
for pk,fk in clskey_options().items():
    for mk in MEMF:
        for order in ['min','max']:
            ok=True; preds={}
            for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6]:
                objs,Lobj,classes,chg,H,W,corner=D2_[n]
                if not classes: ok=False;break
                cl=max(classes,key=fk)
                a,b=cl['v']; fa,fb=cl['fts']
                i=0 if fa[mk]<=fb[mk] else 1
                if order=='max': i=0 if fa[mk]>=fb[mk] else 1
                # tie-break rightmost handled implicitly by <=: keeps a on tie; enforce rightmost explicitly
                if fa[mk]==fb[mk]:
                    i=0 if fa['leftc']>=fb['leftc'] else 1
                m=cl['v'][i]
                preds[n]=(m[1],m[2],m[0]==chg)
                ok=ok and m[0]==chg
            if ok: results.append((pk,mk,order,preds))
for r in results: print("FULL MATCH:",r[0],r[1],r[2])
print("num full:",len(results))

def pairfeats(n):
    gi,go,chg=D[n]
    objs=objlist(gi); Lobj=Lshape(objs); csL=Lobj[0]
    cands=[o for o in objs if o[0]!=csL]
    shapes=defaultdict(list)
    for o in cands: shapes[nshape(o[0])].append(o)
    Lr=[r for r,c in csL]; Lc=[c for r,c in csL]
    Lrows=set(Lr); Lcols=set(Lc)
    out=[]
    for k,v in shapes.items():
        if len(v)!=2: continue
        a,b=v
        def mid(o): 
            rs=[r for r,c in o[0]]; cs=[c for r,c in o[0]]
            return (sum(rs)/len(rs),sum(cs)/len(cs))
        ma,mb=mid(a),mid(b)
        f={}
        f['samerow']=ma[0]==mb[0]; f['samecol']=ma[1]==mb[1]
        f['rowspan_overlap']=len(set(range(min(r for r,c in a[0]),max(r for r,c in a[0])+1)) & set(range(min(r for r,c in b[0]),max(r for r,c in b[0])+1)))>0
        f['colspan_overlap']=len(set(range(min(c for r,c in a[0]),max(c for r,c in a[0])+1)) & set(range(min(c for r,c in b[0]),max(c for r,c in b[0])+1)))>0
        f['between_L']=min(ma,mb)[0]<=sum(Lr)/len(Lr)<=max(ma,mb)[0] and min(ma,mb)[1]<=sum(Lc)/len(Lc)<=max(ma,mb)[1]

        f['one_in_Lcolband']=sum(1 for o in (a,b) if set(range(min(c for r,c in o[0]),max(c for r,c in o[0])+1)) & Lcols)==1
        f['both_touch_Lrows']=sum(1 for o in (a,b) if set(range(min(r for r,c in o[0]),max(r for r,c in o[0])+1)) & Lrows)==2
        f['both_touch_Lcols']=sum(1 for o in (a,b) if set(range(min(c for r,c in o[0]),max(c for r,c in o[0])+1)) & Lcols)==2
        # line between mids passes near L bbox center?
        f['seg_crosses_Lbbox']=False
        import math

def pairdesc_full(gi,diag=False):
    objs,Lobj,fts=setup(gi,diag=diag)
    res=[o for o in objs if o[0]!=Lobj[0]]
    csL=set(Lobj[0]); Hg,Wg=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    Lr=[r for r,c in csL]; Lc=[c for r,c in csL]
    Lbbox=(min(Lr),max(Lr),min(Lc),max(Lc))
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(res)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(res)):
            a,b=res[i],res[j]
            if nshape(a[0])!=nshape(b[0]): continue
            fa,fb=fts[id(a)],fts[id(b)]
            ma=(sum(r for r,c in a[0])/len(a[0]),sum(c for r,c in a[0])/len(a[0]))
            mb=(sum(r for r,c in b[0])/len(b[0]),sum(c for r,c in b[0])/len(b[0]))
            cross=False
            for t in range(41):
                x=ma[0]+(mb[0]-ma[0])*t/40; y=ma[1]+(mb[1]-ma[1])*t/40
                if Lbbox[0]-0.5<=x<=Lbbox[1]+0.5 and Lbbox[2]-0.5<=y<=Lbbox[3]+0.5: cross=True;break
            d={'shapesz':len(nshape(a[0])),'sumtouch':fa['ntouch']+fb['ntouch'],'mintouch':min(fa['ntouch'],fb['ntouch']),
               'maxtouch':max(fa['ntouch'],fb['ntouch']),'sumsz':a[3]+b[3],'maxsz':max(a[3],b[3]),'minsz':min(a[3],b[3]),
               'sumd':fa['d_L']+fb['d_L'],'mind':min(fa['d_L'],fb['d_L']),'maxd':max(fa['d_L'],fb['d_L']),
               'colseq':1 if a[1]==b[1] else 0,'cross':1 if cross else 0,
               'rowdist':abs(ma[0]-mb[0]),'coldist':abs(ma[1]-mb[1]),
               'sumcolcnt':sum(1 for o in objs if o[1]==a[1])+sum(1 for o in objs if o[1]==b[1])}
            out.append(((a,b),d))
    return out,Lobj,fts
# verify rule 8/8
def apply_rule(gi,diag=False):
    prs,Lobj,fts=pairdesc_full(gi,diag)
    if not prs: return None
    best=max(prs,key=lambda p:(p[1]['sumtouch'],p[1]['shapesz']))
    a,b=best[0]; fa,fb=fts[id(a)],fts[id(b)]
    if fa['ntouch']<fb['ntouch']: m=a
    elif fb['ntouch']<fa['ntouch']: m=b
    else: m=a if fa['leftc']>=fb['leftc'] else b
    return m,Lobj,prs

def pfeat(gi,go,chg=None):
    prs,Lo2,res=pdm4(gi,go,chg)
    Lc=set(Lo2[0]); H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    Lr=[r for r,c in Lc]; Lcc=[c for r,c in Lc]
    Lbb=(min(Lr),max(Lr),min(Lcc),max(Lcc))
    from collections import Counter
    ccnt=Counter()
    for row in gi:
        for v in row: ccnt[v]+=1
    out=[]
    for (a,b),s in prs:
        def ntf(o):
            rs=[r for r,c in o[0]]; cll=[c for r,c in o[0]]
            return sum([min(rs)==0,max(rs)==H-1,min(cll)==0,max(cll)==W-1])
        fa,fb=a,b
        d={}
        d['shsz']=s
        d['samecol']=1 if a[1]==b[1] else 0
        d['sumcc']=ccnt[a[1]]+ccnt[b[1]]
        d['mincc']=min(ccnt[a[1]],ccnt[b[1]])
        d['maxcc']=max(ccnt[a[1]],ccnt[b[1]])
        d['sumnt']=ntf(a)+ntf(b)
        d['minnt']=min(ntf(a),ntf(b))
        d['touchL']=1 if (touches(a[0],Lc) or touches(b[0],Lc)) else 0
        d['sumdL']=min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in a[0] for x,y in Lc)+min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in b[0] for x,y in Lc)
        d['mindL']=min(min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in a[0] for x,y in Lc),min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in b[0] for x,y in Lc))
        d['maxtop']=max(min(r for r,c in a[0]),min(r for r,c in b[0]))
        d['mintop']=min(min(r for r,c in a[0]),min(r for r,c in b[0]))
        d['straddle']=1 if (max(c for r,c in a[0])<Lbb[2] and min(c for r,c in b[0])>Lbb[3]) or (max(c for r,c in b[0])<Lbb[2] and min(c for r,c in a[0])>Lbb[3]) else 0
        d['inLrows']=1 if (set(r for r,c in a[0])&set(Lr)) or (set(r for r,c in b[0])&set(Lr)) else 0
        d['inLcols']=1 if (set(c for r,c in a[0])&set(Lcc)) or (set(c for r,c in b[0])&set(Lcc)) else 0
        d['hspan']=(max(c for r,c in a[0]|b[0])-min(c for r,c in a[0]|b[0]))
        d['vspan']=(max(r for r,c in a[0]|b[0])-min(r for r,c in a[0]|b[0]))
        d['samesz']=1
        out.append(((a,b),d))
    return out,Lo2
PF={}

sols2=[]
for r in (1,2):
    for combo in itertools.combinations(kf_keys,r):
        for mode in ('max','min'):

def objfeats2(gi,go,chg):
    objs=normobjs(objects(gi,F,True,False))
    L0=Lshape(objs); Lc=set(L0[0])
    res=[o for o in objs if o[0]!=L0[0]]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    from collections import Counter
    ccnt=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row)
    shapes=Counter(nshape(o[0]) for o in res)
    rowsF={}
    for o in res:
        cs_=o[0]; rs=[r for r,c in cs_]; cll=[c for r,c in cs_]
        ct=(sum(rs)/len(rs),sum(cll)/len(cll))
        f={'sz':o[3],'ntouch':sum([min(rs)==0,max(rs)==H-1,min(cll)==0,max(cll)==W-1]),
           'topc':min(rs),'leftc':min(cll),'botc':max(rs),'rightc':max(cll),
           'ccnt':ccnt[o[1]],
           'dTL':min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in cs_ for x,y in Lc),
           'dTR':min(r+abs(c-(W-1)) for r,c in cs_),
           'dBL':min(abs(r-(H-1))+c for r,c in cs_),
           'dBR':min(abs(r-(H-1))+abs(c-(W-1)) for r,c in cs_),
           'dctr':abs(ct[0]-H/2)+abs(ct[1]-W/2),
           'twin':1 if shapes[nshape(cs_)]>1 else 0,
           'dtop':min(rs)}
        rowsF[id(o)]=(f,o)
    return [rowsF[id(o)] for o in res]

    f['dL']=min(abs(r-x)+abs(c-y) for r,c in cs_ for x,y in Lc)
